svg.text: Latin America draft route (Plan B): Rio → Uruguay → Paraguay → the Andes → Central America
3 Dec 2026 → ≈ mid-Mar 2027 · Brazil dated from the checked itinerary · later dates ≈ pending decisions · faded = optional · dots nudged apart where crowded
12. Punta del Diablo + Cabo Polonio ≈ early Jan
24. San Pedro de Atacama ≈ late Jan
38. Rincón de la Vieja ≈ early Mar
Brazil (Dec) → Uruguay and Paraguay overland → ✈ Iguaçu–Santiago → over the Andes to Mendoza, Salta and the Atacama → Bolivia → Peru → ✈ Lima–San José → north.
Still to decide by ~10–15 Dec: trims vs dropping Honduras to finish by mid-March. Nazca is a daytime stop. Draft for planning, nothing booked.
